study: Prospective direct-symbol contact and three-head span addendum
blinding: Explicitly informed by inspected standalone V1 code and its 29-case result. All three sources, masks, expectations and metrics are frozen before any addendum execution or combined candidate inspection. This is not part of the original blinded suite.
positives: A single broken musical shaft carries three filled heads at upper, middle and lower staff levels. Every one of the three physical-staff owner masks includes the complete source shaft and all three heads (1,625 pixels each). All three owner crops must preserve every original pixel and envelope; pairing adjacent heads cannot justify dropping a distant head from an owner. Source scan gaps remove the same pixels from all masks.
negativePP: Two pp-shaped dynamic pairs appear at separate staff heights and touch one long structural barline with their right bowls. Each includes a companion p, upright local letter stroke and descender; the original source therefore supplies text context beyond a round body. Local glyph pixels belong only to that printed staff; the connecting barline remains structural. No inter-staff musical interval may be invented.
negativeFlat: Two flat-shaped accidentals touch a long structural barline, each with its own tall left ascender and a separate local stemmed note to the right at matching pitch. This original source context distinguishes an accidental from a head; no continuous musical ownership of the barline is authorized. Each glyph and following note belong only to its local staff.
sourceLimits: These are deliberately difficult synthetic source collisions, not real score excerpts. The pp case extends the structural barline slightly below the last core to contact the lower glyph. No source is byte-identical to a musical positive under a different label.
metrics: Exact original owned pixel loss sets for every owner; no newly lost pixel relative to unchanged production baseline
Full source-envelope and pixel recovery for every positive owner, not just aggregate improvement
All raw candidate span witnesses including those deduplicated into unchanged final components
Spurious whole-neighbor cores and falsely claimed shared intervals reported separately from note preservation
Original 29-case suite and all previous source guards remain unchanged
noRetuning: Do not revise fixtures, masks, thresholds or expected ownership after addendum results. Preserve baseline failures. No production edit or shipping claim follows from this bounded study alone.
